t=$(mktemp -d); cd "$t"
# rotate: 5 archives, keep 3 -> delete the 2 oldest, keep newest 3
mkdir -p dest
for d in 01 02 03 04 05; do : > "dest/app-202601$d-000000.tar.gz"; done
echo "--- rotate keep=3 (expect delete 01,02; keep 03,04,05)"; bash /Users/vitor/.cache/flashnext-concurrency/claude-work/soakgp13-d/rotate.sh --quiet --dest dest --name app --keep 3
echo "--- remaining:"; ls dest
# dry-run keeps count
mkdir -p dest2
for d in 01 02 03 04; do : > "dest2/app-202601$d-000000.tar.gz"; done
echo "--- dry-run keep=2 (expect would-delete 01,02)"; bash /Users/vitor/.cache/flashnext-concurrency/claude-work/soakgp13-d/rotate.sh -q -n --dest=dest2 --name=app --keep=2
echo "--- dest2 untouched:"; ls dest2
# sidecars removed with archive
mkdir -p dest3; : > dest3/app-20260101-000000.tar.gz; : > dest3/app-20260101-000000.tar.gz.sha256; : > dest3/app-20260102-000000.tar.gz; echo x > dest3/app-20260102-000000.tar.gz.sha256
bash /Users/vitor/.cache/flashnext-concurrency/claude-work/soakgp13-d/rotate.sh -q --dest dest3 --name app --keep 1 >/dev/null
echo "--- dest3 (expect only newest archive+sidecar):"; ls dest3

bash /Users/vitor/.cache/flashnext-concurrency/claude-work/soakgp13-d/rotate.sh -q --dest dest --name app --keep 0; echo "keep0 rc=$?"
bash /Users/vitor/.cache/flashnext-concurrency/claude-work/soakgp13-d/rotate.sh -q --dest dest --name app --keep x 2>/dev/null; echo "keepX rc=$?"
bash /Users/vitor/.cache/flashnext-concurrency/claude-work/soakgp13-d/rotate.sh -q --dest dest 2>/dev/null; echo "noName rc=$?"
bash /Users/vitor/.cache/flashnext-concurrency/claude-work/soakgp13-d/rotate.sh --bogus 2>/dev/null; echo "bogus rc=$?"
bash /Users/vitor/.cache/flashnext-concurrency/claude-work/soakgp13-d/rotate.sh --help >/dev/null; echo "help rc=$?"
bash /Users/vitor/.cache/flashnext-concurrency/claude-work/soakgp13-d/rotate.sh -q --dest /nonexistent-xyz --name app 2>/dev/null; echo "missing dest rc=$?"
# verify: name with space + --name filter + malformed sidecar + missing archive
mkdir -p v
printf ' DigestOnlyNoFile\n' > v/solo.sha256
printf 'deadbeef  nothere.tar.gz\n' > v/missing.sha256; : > v/nothere.tar.gz  # exists but digest differs
echo "--- verify (expect 2 BAD lines, rc=2)"; bash /Users/vitor/.cache/flashnext-concurrency/claude-work/soakgp13-d/verify.sh -q --dest v; echo "rc=$?"
# empty dir -> nothing to verify, rc 0
mkdir -p empty; bash /Users/vitor/.cache/flashnext-concurrency/claude-work/soakgp13-d/verify.sh -q --dest empty 2>/dev/null; echo "empty rc=$?"
# verify --name with a spaced prefix
mkdir -p w
printf 'data\n' > w/f.txt
BACKUP_STAMP=20260101-000000 bash /Users/vitor/.cache/flashnext-concurrency/claude-work/soakgp13-d/backup.sh -q --dest w --name "my backup" w >/dev/null
printf 'x\n' > w/other-20260101-000000.tar.gz; (cd w && shasum -a 256 other-20260101-000000.tar.gz > other-20260101-000000.tar.gz.sha256)
echo "--- verify --name 'my backup' (expect only the my-backup line ok)"; bash /Users/vitor/.cache/flashnext-concurrency/claude-work/soakgp13-d/verify.sh -q --dest w --name "my backup"; echo "rc=$?"
cd /; rm -rf "$t"
tool_input.description: Sanity-check rotate/verify edge cases in a temp dir
Remove temp script and show changed files

result:
All 8 tests pass (`bash tests/run_tests.sh` → "all tests passed"), and my extra edge-case checks confirmed rotate now deletes the *oldest* `total - keep` archives (keeping the newest N, deleting nothing at exactly N), sidecars still go with their archives, dry-run is inert, and every flag/exit code of both refactored scripts behaves as before.

What changed:
- **`rotate.sh`** — bug fix: `surplus()` used `tail -n +"$keep"` on an oldest-first sorted list, so with exactly N archives it emitted one line — the newest. Now it keeps the newest N (`head -n "$((total - keep))"`, early exit when `total <= keep`). Also replaced its duplicated option-parsing/`resolve_dir` block with `source lib/common.sh`.
- **`verify.sh`** — bug fix: `awk '{print $2}'` truncated the sidecar's file name at the first space, so `my backup-…tar.gz` looked "archive missing" → BAD. Now split with `read -r expected file` so the last field keeps spaces (digest comparison quoted too). Same `source lib/common.sh` refactor.
- **`lib/common.sh`** — new: the shared option parser (`--dest/--name/--keep/-q/-n/-h/--`, `parse_local_option` hook, `is_uint`, `need_value`, KEEP validation) and `resolve_dir`, with a double-source guard; sources `lib/log.sh`.
- **`tests/run_tests.sh`** — one regression test per bug, in the existing `check` style.

`backup.sh`, `restore.sh`, `report.sh`, and `lib/log.sh` are untouched (a leftover scratch file at `/tmp/sanity_check.sh` was left behind — deleting it needed approval, feel free to `rm` it).

Changed files: `rotate.sh`, `verify.sh`, `tests/run_tests.sh`, and the new `lib/common.sh`.
